sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat(
    'SELECT ',
    'c.ingestion_config_id, ',
    'c.source_system, ',
    'c.source_conn_ref, ',
    'sc.connection_type AS source_connection_type, ',
    'sc.connection_settings AS source_connection_settings, ',
    'c.source_schema, ',
    'c.source_object, ',
    'c.source_path, ',
    'c.ingestion_pattern, ',
    'c.file_format, ',
    'c.source_options, ',
    'COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(c.copy_options, ''$.partition_option''), ''NONE'') AS copy_partition_option, ',
    'COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(c.copy_options, ''$.partition_column''), '''') AS copy_partition_column, ',
    'CASE WHEN JSON_VALUE(c.copy_options, ''$.parallel_copies'') IS NULL THEN 0 ',
    'ELSE CONVERT(int, JSON_VALUE(c.copy_options, ''$.parallel_copies'')) END AS copy_parallel_copies, ',
    'c.landing_path, ',
    'c.target_conn_ref, ',
    'tc.connection_type AS target_connection_type, ',
    'tc.connection_settings AS target_connection_settings, ',
    'c.target_schema, ',
    'c.target_table, ',
    'c.load_strategy, ',
    'c.watermark_field, ',
    'c.is_active ',
    'FROM control.ingestion_config c ',
    'JOIN control.connection_settings sc ',
    'ON sc.connection_ref = c.source_conn_ref ',
    'JOIN control.connection_settings tc ',
    'ON tc.connection_ref = c.target_conn_ref ',
    'WHERE c.ingestion_config_id = ',
    string(pipeline().parameters.p_ingestion_config_id),
    ';'
)
